final_response_fingerprint.title: Research niri hotkeys
final_response_fingerprint.user_intention: Find options, including plugins or native features, for discovering niri hotkeys and summarize common keybinding adjustments users make.

final_response_fingerprint.feedback_loop: Searched current web sources, inspected the installed niri 26.04 version and its local KDL bindings, confirmed official hotkey-overlay-title behavior and Noctalia Keymap's niri support, and summarized common customization patterns with clear distinction between anecdotal examples and population claims.
final_response_fingerprint.stopping_evidence: Official niri wiki and Noctalia plugin page support discovery options; CachyOS guide and local config provide examples of common mappings. No authoritative usage survey found, so findings are framed as recurring patterns, not statistics.
